cases.exposure_context_quote: presented to the hospital 1 h after ingesting 100 mL of a homemade liquid containing pentahydrate copper sulfate (concentration 38%)
cases.agent: copper sulfate pentahydrate (38% homemade liquid, 100 mL ingested)
cases.agent_quote: ingesting 100 mL of a homemade liquid containing pentahydrate copper sulfate (concentration 38%)
cases.circumstance: Ingestion of homemade copper sulfate solution; patient had a history of anxiety and depressive states treated with fluvoxamine maleate and aripiprazole; self-induced vomiting half an hour before emergency admission

symptoms.quote: The patient developed nausea, vomiting of bile-green gastric contents, and periumbilical abdominal pain approximately 5–6 min after ingestion
The patient developed nausea, vomiting of bile-green gastric contents, and periumbilical abdominal pain approximately 5–6 min after ingestion
The patient continued to complain of abdominal pain, most notably around the umbilical region.

labs.name: serum copper
labs.quote: Toxicological analysis revealed a serum copper concentration of 3775.0 ng/mL (reference interval: 800–1,900 ng/mL).

treatment.name: gastric lavage
treatment.quote: Upon admission, Gastric lavage was performed approximately 1 h after ingestion.

treatment.name: egg white and milk (gastric mucosa protection)
treatment.quote: administration of egg white and milk to dilute toxic substances for protecting the gastric mucosa

treatment.name: fluid replacement
treatment.quote: fluid replacement, and glutathione at a dose of 2.4 g/d by intravenous infusion for 3 consecutive days

treatment.name: glutathione 2.4 g/d IV for 3 days
treatment.quote: glutathione at a dose of 2.4 g/d by intravenous infusion for 3 consecutive days to counteract copper-induced oxidative stress and hepatic injury

treatment.name: sodium dimercaptopropanesulfonate (Na-DMPS) chelation
treatment.quote: sodium dimercaptopropanesulfonate (Na-DMPS) was administered at a daily dose of 0.125 g for three consecutive days as copper chelation therapy

cases.outcome: recovered and discharged after 1 week; normal labs at 10-day follow-up
cases.outcome_quote: The patient reported no discomfort and was discharged after 1 week. Ten days post-discharge, follow-up revealed no reports of symptoms, and retesting showed serum copper, urine copper, complete blood count, and liver and kidney function all within normal ranges
cases.sequelae: none reported (no symptoms and normal labs at 10-day follow-up)
cases.notes: Blood count, liver/kidney function, electrolytes, cardiac enzymes, troponin showed no significant abnormalities on admission. Serum copper normalized on day 4.
